annotations.title: Upvote a feature request or issue

description: Adds your upvote to a feature request or issue (a "me too"); votes decide what gets built and fixed first, and you get an email when its status changes. Idempotent: one vote per account. A vote on a duplicate goes to the original. Free; needs a key. Returns the item with its new vote count. Needs an API key or a connected account.

id.description: The item's id from list_feedback, request_feature or report_issue (e.g. 42).
